item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #MINPRSD
Issued at 09:25 AM 28 November 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #DavaoOccidental, #DavaoDelSur, #DavaoOriental, #DavaoDelNorte, #DavaoDeOro, #DavaoCity, #MisamisOccidental, #MisamisOriental, #Camiguin, #Bukidnon and #LanaoDelNorte within 12 hours.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 FINAL #MINPRSD
Issued at 07:45 PM 27 November 2026

All Thunderstorm Advisories over forecast areas are now terminated. However, all are still advised to continue monitoring for updates.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #MINPRSD
Issued at 05:45 PM 27 November 2026

Light to Moderate rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #MisamisOriental(Salay, Kinoguitan, Binuangan, Sugbongcogon, Balingoan, Talisayan, Medina, GingoogCity, Claveria, Lagonglong, Balingasag, Magsaysay), #Camiguin(Sagay, Guinsiliban, Mahinog), #DavaoOriental(SanIsidro, CityOfMati, Lupon, Banaybanay and Tarragona) within the next 1-2 hours.

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are being experienced in #DavaoCity which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
